answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce token before earning fees. Peers randomly audit signed work, and a false result triggers automatic slashing; reputation and access grow only through successful, cross-checked jobs. Thus spawning thousands of sybils buys no influence for free: the attacker must immobilize capital for every identity and risks losing each bond. Honest agents can price a saffron shipment, inspect a plume, or coordinate at a wharf without trusted names.
